title: thelypteris leucolepis
intro: Thelypteris leucolepis, commonly known as the Leucolepis fern or the Autumn fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris leucolepis are attributed to its ability to reduce coughs, relieve congestion, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
